lines: Obsession will either build you, or burn you.
Five questions. One. Can you stop?
Two. Does it add to your life, or subtract?
Three. Does one bad day wreck who you are?
Four. Do you ignore the warning signs?
Five. If it vanished tomorrow, would there still be a you?
Mostly uncomfortable answers? You hold the leash badly. That is fixable. The full film is on the channel.
